lineDecisions.sourceEvidenceNotes: No conservative source-backed line-specific stock batter and resonant/snare-side head evidence found for Pearl Free Floating records. Do not approve fallback.
No conservative source-backed line-specific stock batter and resonant/snare-side head evidence found for Pearl Sensitone Heritage Alloy records. Do not approve fallback.

Third-party review evidence lists REMO UT heads with coated batter and thin clear resonant side for a Pearl Modern Utility Floor Snare. Because this is third-party review evidence and not official Pearl stock/OEM documentation, do not approve fallback under the conservative policy yet.

Pearl catalog evidence may support Remo USA heads for some Reference/Masters drum sets, but current evidence does not safely identify snare-specific stock batter and resonant/snare-side heads for these Reference snare records. Do not approve fallback.
No conservative source-backed line-specific stock batter and resonant/snare-side head evidence found for Pearl Ultracast records. Do not approve fallback.
No conservative source-backed line-specific stock batter and resonant/snare-side head evidence found for Pearl Signature record. Do not approve fallback.

conclusion: No Pearl line-level stock-head fallback rule is approved under the conservative policy. Modern Utility has third-party evidence only and should remain blocked until official Pearl/OEM confirmation is found.
nextRecommendedStep: Proceed to remaining Lane B companies: Mapex, Tama, Yamaha, Gretsch, and SONOR.
